case.paper_title: The Ideological Congruence Controversy: The Impact of Alternative Measures, Data, and Time Periods on the Effects of Election Rules
case.focal_claim: Under SMD (single member district) election rules, party competition should lead the plurality vote winner to be close to the median voter. (p. 1484.)
case.hypothesis: Plurality vote winners in SMD elections should have smaller Manifesto-method ideological distances from the median voter than plurality vote winners in PR elections.

tasks_info.task_goal: Produce one statistical result comparable to the original paper's focal result.

plan.path_summary: Estimate the SMD-minus-PR mean difference in Manifesto-method plurality-winner distance from the median voter and use a fixed-seed permutation test with bootstrap confidence interval for inference.

path_signature.sample_restriction: Task1 uses authorized observations with smd coded smd or pr and nonmissing pldist1. Task2 additionally applies the instructed 1945-2003 year restriction.
path_signature.missing_data_rule: Listwise deletion for focal variables required by each task: smd and pldist1 for Task1; year, smd, and pldist1 for Task2.
path_signature.variable_construction: Read Stata value labels; clean smd labels to lowercase strings; create smd_bin=1 for smd and 0 for pr; use raw pldist1 without transformation.
path_signature.inference_rule: Expected direction is negative for SMD-minus-PR mean distance. Support requires a negative estimate with p <= 0.05, or borderline support for 0.05 < p <= 0.055 only when the estimate is substantively meaningful and the uncertainty interval narrowly crosses zero. A positive estimate is opposite only with affirmative p < 0.05 evidence and a confidence interval above zero; otherwise inconclusive.

analysis_path.path_description: Use all authorized SMD/PR observations and compare raw Manifesto-method plurality-winner distance between SMD and PR election rules using a fixed-seed permutation test for the mean difference.
preprocessing_steps: Load data/powell_original.dta with Stata categorical value labels.
Record the starting number of rows.
Verify that smd and pldist1 exist.
Create smd_clean by lowercasing and stripping the smd category labels.
Retain rows where smd_clean is smd or pr and record rows removed.
Drop rows with missing pldist1 and record rows removed.
Create smd_bin equal to 1 for smd and 0 for pr.
Compute the SMD-minus-PR mean difference in pldist1.
Compute a two-sided fixed-seed permutation p-value using 100000 permutations.
Compute a fixed-seed within-group percentile bootstrap 95 percent confidence interval using 20000 bootstrap draws.
Classify the result using the prespecified conclusion rule and write result_task1.json and sample_flow_task1.json.

key_choices.outcome_measure: Raw pldist1, the Manifesto-method distance of the plurality vote winner from the median voter.
key_choices.main_predictor_measure: smd_bin, coded 1 for SMD election-rule observations and 0 for PR election-rule observations.
key_choices.sample_restriction: Authorized rows with smd coded smd or pr and nonmissing pldist1.
key_choices.missing_data_rule: Listwise deletion for smd and pldist1 after retaining the focal SMD/PR election-rule categories.
key_choices.data_processing: No aggregation, no scaling, and no outcome transformation; only label cleaning and binary coding of the focal election-rule contrast.
key_choices.model_choice: Fixed-seed randomization/permutation test for the SMD-minus-PR mean difference, with a bootstrap confidence interval.
key_choices.inference_rule: Expected direction is negative. Support requires a negative SMD-minus-PR mean difference with p <= 0.05, or borderline support for 0.05 < p <= 0.055 only when the estimate is substantively meaningful and the uncertainty interval narrowly crosses zero. A positive estimate is opposite only with affirmative p < 0.05 evidence and a confidence interval above zero; otherwise inconclusive.

models.type: Permutation test for independent-group mean difference
models.planned_estimation: SMD-minus-PR mean difference in raw pldist1, two-sided permutation p-value, and bootstrap percentile 95 percent confidence interval
models.inference_criteria: Negative estimate with p <= 0.05 is support; 0.05 < p <= 0.055 is borderline support only if substantively meaningful and the bootstrap interval narrowly crosses zero; positive estimate with p < 0.05 and bootstrap interval above zero is opposite; otherwise inconclusive.
models.qualification: This preserves the focal outcome, contrast, and sample while changing only the inferential test from previously planned regression, quantile, Gamma, Mann-Whitney, and log-outcome paths. A permutation test is defensible for a binary election-rule contrast and a skewed continuous distance outcome because it does not rely on a parametric outcome distribution.

method_justification.claim_alignment: The focal claim predicts plurality vote winners should be close to the median voter under SMD. The proposed path directly compares the raw plurality-winner distance from the median voter in SMD versus PR observations and treats a negative SMD-minus-PR difference as the expected claim-consistent direction.
method_justification.dataset_alignment: Both tasks use only the authorized original Stata file data/powell_original.dta. Task2 explicitly uses years 1945-2003 and the Manifesto-method pldist1 variable.
method_justification.method_reason: A permutation test for an independent-group mean difference is a reasonable robustness analysis for a binary election-rule contrast and a continuous, right-skewed distance outcome. It avoids distributional assumptions while preserving the estimand as a direct average difference in closeness.
method_justification.novelty_reason: Shared Memory already contains raw OLS with and without decade adjustment, median quantile regression, Gamma GLM, Mann-Whitney/Hodges-Lehmann, and a low-quality log-outcome OLS path. This path changes only the test/inference family to a permutation test of the mean difference, avoiding duplication while preserving outcome, contrast, sample logic, and inference direction.

self_check.self_check_note: Both task candidates use the authorized dataset and the same focal claim. The code was written and read back. Referenced columns were verified in the dataset inspection. The path is distinct from prior OLS, quantile, Gamma, Mann-Whitney, and log-outcome candidates.
